blurb: Guests go on private fishing charters on Lake Winnipesaukee guided by Tim Moore, a licensed New Hampshire fishing guide since 2006. The service includes targeting various gamefish species on the lake. Free dock pick up at Ames Farm is offered to customers staying there.
extraNote: Up to 60 Days Prior to Trip: Guests may cancel their reservation and receive a 50% refund of the total booking cost. · 60 Days or Less Prior to Trip: Cancellations made within this period are non-refundable. · Customers more than 30 minutes late without a call, text, or email will be considered a no-show and will not be entitled to a refund or reschedule. · Cancellations for bad weather are at the sole discretion of your guide when fishing conditions become unsafe, not for driving conditions. · Gratuity not included · You may extend your trip for $100/hour when available · We look forward to seeing you. · Dock pick up at Ames Farm for customers staying there
